---
title: "Research"
css: theme/research.css
resources: [js/zoom.js]
include-after-body:
  text: |
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/medium-zoom@1.1.0/dist/medium-zoom.min.js"></script>
    <script src="/js/zoom.js"></script>
# one listing per section, all over data/papers.yml (made by scripts/zotero_sync.py), rendered by _partials/papers.ejs.
# The field listings follow the order of data/fields.yml: keep them in sync.
listing:
  - {id: working,   contents: data/papers.yml, template: _partials/papers.ejs, sort: "year desc", include: {status: working}}
  - {id: published, contents: data/papers.yml, template: _partials/papers.ejs, sort: "year desc", include: {status: published}}
  - {id: wip,       contents: data/papers.yml, template: _partials/papers.ejs, sort: "year desc", include: {status: wip}}
  - {id: econometric-methods, contents: data/papers.yml, template: _partials/papers.ejs, sort: "year desc", include: {field: Econometric methods}}
  - {id: mechanism-design,    contents: data/papers.yml, template: _partials/papers.ejs, sort: "year desc", include: {field: Mechanism design}}
  - {id: applied-research,    contents: data/papers.yml, template: _partials/papers.ejs, sort: "year desc", include: {field: Applied research}}
---

```{=html}
<script>
  (() => {
    const root = document.querySelector('.publications');
    const buttons = root.querySelectorAll('.sort-toggle button');
    const show = (sort) => {
      root.classList.toggle('sort-field', sort === 'field');
      buttons.forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.sort === sort));
      try { localStorage.setItem('pubSort', sort); } catch (e) {}
    };
    buttons.forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => show(b.dataset.sort)));
    let saved = null;
    try { saved = localStorage.getItem('pubSort'); } catch (e) {}
    if (saved) show(saved);
  })();
</script>
```
